description: Ordered CPU NativeVNNI serial M=1 accumulation and K-part reduction arithmetic used as the bitwise oracle for grouped verifier rows.
invariants: Each output element accumulates K blocks in increasing source order.
K-part partials are reduced in increasing tile order with the production FP32 reduction routine.
N-chunk scheduling and learned dispatch selection may change without changing this arithmetic contract.
Any change to accumulation precision, K partition boundaries, reduction order, or correction arithmetic requires a new contract version and hash.
